cards.name: Canton Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers do crafts, play games, swim, and participate in outdoor activities at Recreation Park. Groups are separated by rising grade, with weekly themes and community visitors.

hours.text: 7:30 – 8:45am Drop off at Recreation Park; 4:00 – 5:30pm Pick up begins at Rec Park’s Basketball Courts

lunch.text: Campers need to bring their own lunch and snacks for the day.
